title: EasyFAB activity operations v1
description: Normal revalidated sessions only, active workspace derived by Rust. project_detail({projectId}) returns project, entries [{owner_id,owner_name,revision,activity,decision}], can_edit and can_review. revision is SHA256 of the persisted activity with supervisor_approved=false. Engineer reads/writes only own activities on projects where engineer_ids contains session ID. Admin/Supervisor read activities of authorized projects; only the sole active Supervisor reviews. save_activity({input}) creates when id/expected_revision are null, otherwise updates own existing activity only when expected_revision matches. 100 requests review; it does not complete or approve work. attach_evidence({input}) adds immutable bytes and updates own profile only after file publication. Failed profile publication may leave an unreferenced complete file; retries never reuse partial files. read_evidence accepts projectId, ownerId, activityId, evidenceId (not a path), authorizes and verifies size/SHA256. review_activity({input}) appends a signed decision under data/reviews/<id>.json; accepted=true requires gate 100 and all referenced evidence verified. Rejection requires a comment. Decisions apply only to their exact content revision. Any edit changes revision_id. Legacy profile flags cannot grant approval. Layout 1 must be explicitly upgraded before attaching. No automatic layout migration or attachment deletion. Detail includes engineer_progress [{engineer_id,engineer_name,progress}] for assigned Engineers (own declaration only for Engineer sessions). declared_progress is the visible sole declaration, otherwise null; no project aggregate is inferred. Each Engineer writes only their own profile. Activated result-oriented projects use project_results_operations.schema.json. Legacy mutations are rejected after activation. project_detail returns a reporting compatibility projection with can_edit/can_review=false, supervisor_approved=false and no inferred personal progress; 100 percent of an activity is execution only. New acceptance is per deliverable.

wbs.description: Compatibility input, ignored by Rust; WBS is generated internally. Empty string is accepted.

hours_spent.description: Accumulated worked hours; omitted/null means unknown, never zero by default.
